hints.title: Bidirectional Graph Expansion
hints.text: Augment the graph with backward edges whose weights include the reversal penalty.

hints.title: Priority Queue Exploration
hints.text: Explore paths from source to target in order of increasing total accumulated cost.

hints.title: Target Early Exit
hints.text: Terminate search immediately when the destination node is extracted from the queue.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Standard shortest path with augmented reverse transition edges.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all simple paths takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Doubles the edge list to allow simulated edge inversions.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Represent edge reversal as an additional weighted directed edge.
